# Relix v0.2 "Polish & Juice": team contracts

The goal is AAA feel, mobile first and **portrait first**. The primary device is the **iPhone 16 Pro**: CSS viewport 402×874, DPR 3, safe area about 59px top (Dynamic Island) and 34px bottom. Must also work on small Android (360×780, DPR 2–3), Pro Max (440×956), iPad (portrait and landscape) and desktop. Landscape is supported, but portrait is the reference.

## Ownership (do NOT edit files you don't own)
| Owner | Files |
|---|---|
| **Lead** (integration) | `index.html`, `css/style.css`, `js/main.js`, `js/engine.js`, `js/bot.js`, `js/board.js`, `js/render3d.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/cosmetics.js`, `js/haptics.js`, `js/flow.js` |
| **Dice** | `js/dice3d.js`, `css/dice.css`, `vendor/cannon-es.js` (if used), `dev/dice.html` |
| **Battle** | `js/battle.js`, `css/battle.css`, `dev/battle.html` |
| **Audio** | `js/audio.js`, `assets/audio/**` (incl. `CREDITS.md`), `dev/audio.html` |
| **Menus** | `js/menus.js`, `js/profile.js`, `js/banner.js`, `js/guildui.js`, `css/menus.css`, `assets/ui/menu/**`, `dev/menus.html` |

Everyone may read anything. If you need a change in a file you don't own, say so in your final report and the lead will make it.

## Shared rules
- Plain ES modules with no build step. Import Three.js from `../vendor/three.module.min.js` (r170).
- The network allows npm and GitHub only. Vendor any library into `vendor/` with a license header. Use only MIT, Apache or CC0 licensed material.
- Each module ships a standalone `dev/<module>.html` test page. Check your work with Playwright screenshots at 402×874 (`is_mobile`, `has_touch`, DPR 3) and 1280×800. Chrome: `/usr/bin/google-chrome` with `--use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader`.
- Touch: use Pointer Events. Hit targets are at least 44×44 CSS px, with no hover-only UI. Respect `env(safe-area-inset-*)`. Use `touch-action` correctly. A tap must register even if the finger moves up to ~12px.
- Performance: 60fps on a mid-range phone. Pause your render loop when hidden. Run at most 1 extra WebGL context at a time.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` with shorter or simpler animations.
- Visual language matches the game: dark fantasy purple/black, gold `#f2c443`, card olive `#a39b00`, brown `#5c5046`. Fonts are `'Luckiest Guy'` (titles), `'Lilita One'` (card text) and `'Nunito'` (UI), already loaded by `css/style.css`. Art is in `assets/chars/*.webp` (transparent chibi art) and `assets/ui/*`.
- Cosmetic ids come from `js/cosmetics.js`; never invent ids elsewhere.
- Commit on your branch with clear messages. Do not push. The lead merges and pushes to `main`.

## Module contracts

### Dice: `js/dice3d.js`
```js
export class DiceTray {
  constructor(opts?)                     // creates its own full-screen overlay (fixed, z-index 40) + canvas, hidden by default
  // Throw dice that MUST land on `values` (results are decided by the game engine beforehand).
  // mode 'swipe': shows a prompt ("Swipe to throw"), the player flicks; swipe direction/speed shapes the throw.
  // mode 'auto': throws immediately (bots, or when the player turned swiping off).
  // kind tints results: 'combat' (6 crit gold, 4-5 hit green, 2-3 miss red, 1 crit-miss dark red),
  // 'skill' (triggers = array of values that succeed → gold, else grey), 'move' / 'pvp' / 'plain' (neutral).
  async roll({ values, mode, kind, triggers, label, skin, throwFx, area, speed }) // resolves after the dice settle + result highlight
  // area: optional DOMRect where the dice should land (the battle scene passes the gap between fighters). Default: centre of screen.
  // speed: 0.15–1 multiplier for bot pacing; < 0.05 = resolve instantly (test mode).
  hide()
}
```
Use real 3D dice and physics (e.g. vendored cannon-es): they tumble, bounce off invisible walls and scatter. The faces must come up as `values`, e.g. by simulating first and then remapping the face textures. Each skin renders from `DICE_SKINS`, and the throw trail and landing burst from `THROW_FX`. Fire `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('relix:sfx', {detail:{name:'dice_hit'|'dice_throw'|'dice_settle', intensity}}))` so Audio can respond. Support up to 6 dice.

### Battle: `js/battle.js`
A Fire Emblem-style cut-in. The board dims, and the two fighters' full art (no card frame) faces off on a stage with a themed backdrop. Each has a name and HP bar under their feet.
```js
export class BattleScene {
  constructor(opts?)                     // own overlay element (z-index 30)
  async open({ left, right, kind, theme }) // left/right: {id, name, art, hp, maxHp, atk, side:'hero'|'enemy', banner?}; kind 'monster'|'boss'|'pvp'; theme from BOSSES[i].theme. Plays an intro (fighters slide in, VS flash).
  diceArea()                             // DOMRect between the fighters for DiceTray
  async strike(from, { dmg, crit, miss }) // 'left'|'right' lunges/attacks; the other side reacts; damage number pops; screen shake on crit
  setHp(side, hp)                        // animated bar drain
  async skill(side, text)                // flashy banner over the fighter ("RAGE +5", "SHIELD −3")
  async defeat(side, killFx)             // death animation using KILL_FX id
  async close()
  get isOpen()
}
```
Fire `relix:sfx` events (`hit`, `crit`, `miss`, `whoosh`, `ko`, `vs`) the same way.

### Audio: `js/audio.js`
```js
export const audio = {
  unlock(),                // call on first user gesture (iOS)
  sfx(name, opts?),        // synthesized via Web Audio (no files needed) or tiny files
  music(trackId),          // crossfade; ids: 'title','menu','floor1'..'floor5','boss','victory','defeat'
  stopMusic(), setVolume({ music, sfx }), get volumes,
};
```
It also listens to `window` `relix:sfx` events. Required SFX names: `tap, back, open, card_flip, card_draw, coin, dice_throw, dice_hit, dice_settle, step, hit, crit, miss, ko, whoosh, vs, heal, hurt, trap, boss_roar, boss_skill, relic, victory, defeat, pvp, guild, scroll, error, turn`. Music is CC0, from GitHub/npm only, with a full license record in `assets/audio/CREDITS.md`. Use mp3 or m4a (iOS safe), with the total under ~12MB. Generate any missing track procedurally.

### Menus: `js/menus.js`, `js/profile.js`, `js/banner.js`, `js/guildui.js`
- `profile.js`:
  - `loadProfile()` and `saveProfile(p)` use localStorage key `relix.profile.v1`.
  - Profile shape: `{ name, banner, dice, throwFx, killFx, coins, owned:[ids], settings:{music, sfx, haptics, swipeDice, speed, reducedMotion} }`.
  - `awardCoins(n)`, `own(id)`, `buy(id, price)`.
- `banner.js`: `drawBanner(canvas, banner, {w,h, wave})` draws a heraldic banner (field, accent pattern, emblem, optional name ribbon). Swallow-tail pennant shape. It must look good at 48px (HUD) and 512px (3D flag texture). Also `bannerDataURL(banner, w, h)`.
- `menus.js`: `initMenus({ startGame(config), audio })` takes over `#title`, `#setup` and new screens: **Customize** (banner editor with live preview; dice / throw / kill effect pickers that preview the dice and effects), **Shop** (buy cosmetics with coins; locked/owned states; "real shop coming soon"), **Settings** (music/SFX volume, haptics, swipe-to-roll, game speed, reduced motion), **How to Play**, **Card Gallery** (reuse `js/cards.js`).
  - The title screen should be AAA: animated hero lineup, parallax, a logo treatment, ambient particles.
  - `startGame(config)` receives `{ mode, speed, players:[{hero, bot, name, banner}] }`. Human seat 1 uses the profile banner; others get `SEAT_BANNERS`.
- `guildui.js`:
  - `await inviteScroll({ from:{name, art, banner}, to:{name, art}, guildName }) → 'yes'|'no'`: a scroll that unrolls with a wax seal, accept or decline.
  - `await nameGuild({ leader:{name, art}, banner, suggested }) → string`: name entry with the suggestion prefilled.
  - Full-screen overlays (z-index 50).

- Bigger Start and Boss platforms.
- Turn flow and immersion (`js/flow.js`):
  - Turn banner, tap-to-continue moments, a card draw/flip reveal.

- 3D guild flags above heroes, plus guild banners in the HUD.
